title: Checkout database latency
summary: Checkout requests exceeded the latency SLO during peak traffic.
resolution: A missing composite index caused sequential scans. Add the index, verify the query plan, and monitor p95 latency.

title: Payment queue backlog
summary: Payment events accumulated faster than consumers processed them.
resolution: One consumer group was crash-looping on a malformed payload. Quarantine the payload and restore healthy consumers.

title: Expired TLS certificate
summary: A partner API rejected outbound HTTPS connections.
resolution: Rotate the expired client certificate and add an alert 30 days before future expiration.

title: Memory growth in worker
summary: Document workers restarted repeatedly after reaching their memory limit.
resolution: A response body was retained across jobs. Release the buffer after each job and validate heap stabilization.

title: Authentication clock skew
summary: Valid tokens were intermittently rejected as not yet active.
resolution: Synchronize node clocks and allow the approved small token clock-skew tolerance.

title: Search index lag
summary: New knowledge documents did not appear in search results.
resolution: The indexing consumer lost its subscription. Restore it and replay events from the retained offset.

title: Connection pool exhaustion
summary: The case API timed out while PostgreSQL remained healthy.
resolution: Unclosed transactions exhausted the pool. Close sessions in a finally block and alert on pool saturation.

title: Incorrect cache key
summary: Users occasionally saw another tenant's case summary.
resolution: Include tenant ID in the cache key, purge affected entries, and add isolation tests.

title: RabbitMQ disk alarm
summary: Publishers were blocked and case-created events stopped flowing.
resolution: Free disk space, confirm the alarm clears, and lower retention for noncritical development queues.

title: Deployment health-check mismatch
summary: A healthy service was repeatedly removed from rotation.
resolution: Align the container health-check path and port with the service listener.

title: Slow vector search
summary: Knowledge retrieval exceeded the response-time budget.
resolution: Create the appropriate vector index, analyze the table, and bound the candidate result count.

title: Duplicate case events
summary: A retry created duplicate downstream timeline entries.
resolution: Use the event ID as an idempotency key and enforce uniqueness in the consumer store.

title: Provider rate limiting
summary: AI diagnoses failed during a burst of new cases.
resolution: Add bounded exponential backoff, concurrency limits, and a user-visible queued state.

title: Malformed environment URL
summary: The web gateway could not reach the knowledge service.
resolution: Correct the service URL, validate configuration at startup, and cover it in Compose smoke tests.

title: Stale DNS record
summary: Traffic continued reaching a retired service instance.
resolution: Lower TTL before migrations and remove the stale record after confirming propagation.

title: Oversized audit output
summary: Automation execution logs consumed excessive database storage.
resolution: Truncate captured output, store a digest, and move full artifacts to bounded object storage.

title: Failed database migration
summary: A schema migration locked the case table during deployment.
resolution: Roll back, split the migration into online steps, and test lock duration on production-scale data.

title: Webhook signature failure
summary: Partner callbacks were rejected after secret rotation.
resolution: Support overlapping secrets during rotation and record which key verified each callback.

title: Incorrect role mapping
summary: Analysts could see the approve action but received a server rejection.
resolution: Map Keycloak roles consistently and hide unauthorized UI actions while retaining server enforcement.

title: Container disk pressure
summary: The automation service became unavailable on one node.
resolution: Rotate container logs, enforce size limits, and alert before node disk exhaustion.

title: Missing correlation ID
summary: A case request could not be traced across gateway and services.
resolution: Generate a correlation ID at ingress and propagate it through logs, events, and provider calls.

title: Prompt context overflow
summary: Large retrieved documents caused AI provider request rejection.
resolution: Chunk documents, rerank results, and enforce a context token budget before calling the model.

title: Case form double submit
summary: Users created duplicate cases by clicking submit twice.
resolution: Disable the submit action while pending and add a server-side idempotency key.

title: Unbounded search query
summary: A broad knowledge query consumed excessive CPU.
resolution: Limit query length and result count, add a statement timeout, and cache safe repeated searches.

title: Automation target typo
summary: An approved action referenced a nonexistent container.
resolution: Validate targets against an inventory and return a clear audited failure without attempting a shell fallback.
